description:
Params for `tool.tab_borrow`. Moves a *user* tab into the
requesting session's Agent Window, recording its original window /
index so `tab_return` (or session_stop) can put it back.

confirm.description: Legacy input, ignored. Browser settings decide whether confirmation is required.

confirmation_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for user confirmation (default 60 seconds).

title: TabBorrowParams
